author: Fareed
description: Cooperative bank heist minigame: signup window, wagering, jail penalties for going too greedy.
install_msg: Heist cog installed. Use `[p]heistset` to configure and `[p]heist` to start a heist.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each member's current jail-release timestamp for gameplay purposes only. No other personal data is stored.
